scope: Read-only stored-representation audit against the approved definition-indexed balanced-ternary contract. No aggregate accuracy score; no claim to exhaustive semantic gold.
access: SQLite URI mode=ro with read transactions; no database mutations

replacement_comparison.purpose: Same-spelling illustration only; neither database is treated as gold.

old_schema.name: decompositions
old_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE decompositions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    lexeme_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    primitive TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    polarity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    FOREIGN KEY (lexeme_id) REFERENCES lexemes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

old_schema.name: lexemes
old_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE lexemes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, lemma TEXT NOT NULL, pos TEXT,
  sense_id TEXT, gloss TEXT, frequency_rank INTEGER, confidence REAL,
  validation_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', component_type TEXT, source TEXT DEFAULT 'engine',
  frequency REAL DEFAULT 1.0, content_hash TEXT, comp_primitive TEXT, comp_arity INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  comp_operation TEXT, UNIQUE(lemma,pos,sense_id))

old_schema.name: metadata
old_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE metadata (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT
)

old_schema.name: primitive_values
old_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE primitive_values(lexeme_id INTEGER NOT NULL, primitive TEXT NOT NULL,
  value INTEGER NOT NULL, confidence REAL, source TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(lexeme_id,primitive))

old_schema.name: sentence_primitive_values
old_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE sentence_primitive_values(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, lexeme_id INTEGER NOT NULL, primitive TEXT NOT NULL,
  value INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, confidence REAL DEFAULT 1.0, source TEXT DEFAULT 'inferred',
  UNIQUE(lexeme_id,primitive))

old_schema.name: vectors
old_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE vectors (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    lexeme_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    positive_indices BLOB,
    negative_indices BLOB,
    FOREIGN KEY (lexeme_id) REFERENCES lexemes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

checks.scope: Only stored names in the approved 56-coordinate basis; semantic signs are not independently gold-validated.

checks.reason: Exactly one lexeme per spelling, generic POS/sense identifiers, and missing definitions for almost all rows do not fulfill the approved one-entry-per-definition contract.
No stored zero values and no definition-state domains. Sparse omissions cannot distinguish justified orthogonality from unresolved banks.

Empty metadata; legacy negative-pole labels and HIER/NUMBER entries coexist with ordinary coordinates, without component-target hierarchy metadata. This is not the approved versioned 56-coordinate artifact; it is not a claim that every legacy alias is meaningless.
Schema and same-spelling comparisons cannot establish intended definition or sign correctness for every entry. The old database is not gold; the replacement is also partial.

example_interpretation.want: Old spelling row has WANT=1. Replacement separates exact native senses; the approved desire sense is not interchangeable with deprivation senses.
example_interpretation.very_and_extremely: Old spelling rows use INTENSITY plus HIER_PLUS values 1 and 2. Replacement exact intensifier definitions attach hierarchy to INTENSITY, while other senses retain separate identities. No spelling-wide inheritance is warranted.
example_interpretation.he: Old closed-class row has SOMEONE=1. Replacement native WordNet entries denote helium and a Hebrew letter. These are different definitions, so coordinate differences do not prove the pronoun assignment wrong. They expose a missing catalog-definition identity adapter.
example_interpretation.equal_vectors: Distinct lexical identities may legitimately share coordinates; equality of vectors is not itself an error.

limitations: No live runtime execution in this audit.
No claim of complete lexical sense coverage in either artifact.
No claim that missing metadata makes every stored sign semantically false.
